subject: REPOSITORY paragraph
notes: kb/Work PB1086/PB2103: Rule (cite.py --check 12.3.8.3 'the name of a program for which information exists in the external repository' -> OK 12.3.8.3 14)): literal-3 / program-prototype-name-1 shall be a program prototype of this group, a program definition specified PREVIOUSLY in this group, or a program with external-repository information. Verified: BindProgramSpecifier records the specifier (SR1/SR2 screened), ProgramPrototypesOf resolves it through RepositoryResolver.ResolveProgram over the group (alternatives 1 and 2, in source order - a definition that follows the paragraph is not the second alternative, kb/Work PB989) and then the external repository's entries (alternative 3), and a specifier none answers is REPO-1 (COBOL5962, SR14) at the specifier, used by a CALL or not - no program is looked for at run time to make it legal. Witnesses: alternative 1 pb989-call-previous-definition-argument-count; alternative 2 pb237_program_prototype, pb894_program_prototype_2002; alternative 3 pb2103_prototype_group_split_across_units and ExternalRepositoryResolutionTests.ACallerIsCheckedAgainstTheEntryInItsOutputDirectory; the refusal is the new golden pb1086-program-specifier-no-information (COBOL5962 at 2002, 2014, 2023), ASpecifierNoProviderAnswers_IsRepo1_NamingThePlacesSearched and RepositoryDetailsOrderTests.AProgramDefinitionThatFollowsTheCaller_IsNotGr10A_AndNoProviderAnswersTheSpecifier. Re-probed 2026-11-03 on the PB1086 branch (kb/Work PB1086): the note's own sr10.cob (REPOSITORY. FUNCTION NOSUCHFN, FUNCTION ALIASFN AS "NOSUCH-EXT", PROGRAM NOSUCHPG, CLASS NOSUCHCL, INTERFACE NOSUCHIF, PROPERTY NOSUCHPR) is refused at --std 2023 with COBOL5962 at each of the six specifiers, naming the rule (SR10, SR14, SR6, SR9, SR16) and the places searched; sr6.cob (PROGRAM NOSUCHPG + CALL NOSUCHPG ON EXCEPTION) is refused COBOL5962 at the specifier instead of printing NOT-FOUND at run time. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Linkage.cs#BindProgramSpecifier (BindProgramSpecifier is declared in DataBinder.Switches.cs; DataBinder.Linkage.cs names it only in a comment) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Switches.cs#BindProgramSpecifier (kb/Work PB2355 extracted the SPECIAL-NAMES binding out of DataBinder.Switches.cs into the SpecialNamesBinder class (its partial files) and the configuration-section services DataBinder keeps into DataBinder.Configuration.cs; each member is the same rule, moved with its body unchanged)
